total_return_proxy.methodology_disclaimer: NIFTYBEES.NS is an exchange-traded fund tracking NIFTY 50 with automatic dividend reinvestment into the portfolio basket. Used as an investable Total Return Index proxy. Reflects real fund-level frictions including ~4 bps TER and bid-ask spreads, avoiding artificial synthetic dividend yield modeling.
